title: HumanSkill-4D: Training-Free Language Querying of Animatable Gaussian Avatars in Space and Time
abstract: arXiv:2610.24452v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We introduce avatar referring segmentation, which selects regions of animatable Gaussian avatars from language queries. A query can also specify a pose or motion to select matching intervals. This lets users interact with avatars for local editing and motion inspection. However, making these selections with existing language Gaussian splatting methods poses two challenges: adjacent parts and garments are hard to separate and may be referred to indirectly (region ambiguity), while fine-grained motions can look alike in RGB (motion ambiguity). We address these challenges with HumanSkill-4D, a training-free framework that shares a multimodal large language model (MLLM) and geometric operators across avatars. For each avatar, a semantic memory links body-part and garment categories to persistent Gaussian regions and appearance descriptions. The MLLM uses category names and descriptions to select categories by appearance, relation,

translated_title: HumanSkill-4D：可动画高斯化身在空间与时间上的免训练语言查询
translated_abstract: 我们提出了“化身指代分割”这一新任务，即通过语言查询从可动画高斯化身中选择相应区域。查询还可以指定姿态或动作来筛选匹配的时间区间。这使得用户能够与化身进行交互，实现局部编辑和动作检查。然而，使用现有的语言高斯泼溅方法来完成这些选择面临两大挑战：相邻的部位与服装难以分离，且可能被间接指代（区域歧义），而细粒度的动作在RGB图像中可能看起来相似（动作歧义）。我们通过HumanSkill-4D来解决这些挑战，这是一个免训练的框架，可在多个化身之间共享多模态大语言模型（MLLM）和几何算子。对于每个化身，语义记忆将身体部位和服装类别与持久的高斯区域及外观描述关联起来。MLLM利用类别名称和描述，根据外观、关系等选择相应类别，
tldr: HumanSkill-4D提出了一种免训练框架，通过共享多模态大语言模型与语义记忆，实现对可动画高斯化身的语言指代分割，克服了区域歧义与动作歧义两大挑战，支持局部编辑和动作检查等交互应用。
en_tdlr: HumanSkill-4D introduces a training-free framework that leverages a shared multimodal large language model and semantic memory to enable language-based referring segmentation of animatable Gaussian avatars, overcoming region and motion ambiguity for local editing and motion inspection.
